## Episode Thesis

This is a sponsored personal-finance episode of Rika Tillsammans, paid for by the fund robot Opti. Host Jan Bolmeson talks with Opti's savings psychologist Niklas Laninge about behavioural mistakes that cost investors roughly 1-3 percentage points a year, such as self-serving bias, action bias, confirmation bias, confusing what is familiar with what is right, judging decisions by their outcome, and exponential growth bias. The message is to invest passively in index funds or a fund robot and stop tinkering. The hosts warn against angel investing, prediction markets, crypto and chasing hype such as the SpaceX IPO or the rally in South Korean stocks and silver, and they give no directional view on any listed stock.
